Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looks promising for our summarization flows. Procurement asked me to put together a single request for both a starter credit and a short-term discount so we can run a 6-week POC and evaluate cost run-rate.

Lena — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the docs. Copying Marissa (Sales Lead) and Aditya (Revenue Ops) so we can align on approvals and commitment language.

Quick notes:
- We can typically approve starter credit (up to $25k) at the Sales Lead level for deals that have an active POC plan and exec sponsor.
- The 25% time-limited discount falls into the executive concession bucket if combined with credits; I will need Marissa to sign off and then an exec approval for the combined concession.

Marissa/aditya: can you please confirm whether 20K credit + 25%/60d discount is within the concession band we can approve or whether this should go to exec? Also include any required revenue commitments that procurement expects to see on the SOW.

Next steps for AetherWorks: if you can confirm target models, expected token volumes, and a PO timeline, that will speed review.

Cheers,

- 20K starter credit: approved at Sales Lead for POCs with clear evaluation criteria and PO within 30 days.
- 25% discount for 60 days when combined with a 20K credit: this is borderline for Sales Lead; combined economic impact > $30k and exceeds the normal promo cap. Requires Exec approval (VP/GM signoff).

Requesting the following from Tessa for exec packet:
1) Short mutual action plan (milestones and acceptance criteria)
2) Projected token burn by week for 8 weeks
3) Confirmation of PO timing and billing terms
4) Proposed rollback plan after discount period

I can take the packet to VP tomorrow if Tessa can assemble these quickly.
